communities.name: Tsʼúgé Valley Community Council
communities.country: Fictional composite region (Subarctic North America style)
communities.contact_notes: Primary contact: community language committee, meets monthly. All recordings require council review before public/archival release.
communities.data_sovereignty_agreement: Community retains full ownership of all recordings and derived materials; Kaimira instance operates under a data-sharing MOU renewed annually.

communities.name: Wanua Reef Islands Language Association
communities.contact_notes: Works closely with the island's primary school for revitalization materials.
communities.data_sovereignty_agreement: Materials may be used for educational purposes within the community without further consent; academic publication requires case-by-case approval.

communities.name: Kori Hills Elders' Circle
communities.country: Fictional composite region (West African tonal-language style)
communities.contact_notes: Elders' Circle designated two speakers as lead consultants for the documentation project.
communities.data_sovereignty_agreement: Tonal recordings restricted to research/educational use pending a separate commercial-use agreement.

languages.name: Tsʼúgé (sample)
languages.notes: Fictional composite language created for demonstration purposes only; phonology loosely modeled on Dene (Athabaskan) language typology (ejectives, complex verb morphology). Does not represent any real speech community.

languages.name: Wanua (sample)
languages.notes: Fictional composite language for demonstration purposes; phonology loosely modeled on Austronesian typology (simple CV syllable structure, reduplication). Does not represent any real speech community.

languages.name: Kori (sample)
languages.notes: Fictional composite language for demonstration purposes; phonology loosely modeled on West African tonal-language typology (contrastive tone, ATR vowel harmony). Does not represent any real speech community.

orthographies.name: IPA
orthographies.description: Phonemic IPA transcription used by the documentation team.

orthographies.name: Tsʼúgé Community Orthography
orthographies.description: Practical orthography adopted by the community council in 2019, based on the regional majority-language alphabet with added diacritics for ejectives and nasal vowels.

orthographies.name: Wanua School Orthography
orthographies.description: Orthography taught in the community primary school since 2015.

orthographies.name: Kori Practical Orthography
orthographies.description: Tone marked with accent diacritics over vowels; used in community newsletters.
